referenceSources.description:
A striking yellow Renault Clio V6 Trophy Phase 2 is parked inside a garage, its wide rear wing and dual exhaust pipes immediately drawing attention. The rear bumper features the bold "BERU TOP·10" plate and "elf" branding, while the "Clio v6" badge and Renault Sport logo highlight its pedigree. White racing wheels and sponsor decals such as "FACOM," "4R," and the driver name "H.HARTL" complete the authentic race car appearance.

This rare Cup car, chassis number 65, was one of only 156 built in Dieppe, France, for the Beru Top 10, Renault Clio Speed Trophy Germany, and Europa Cup series from 2000 to 2003. Fully restored to its original factory livery, it features a rebuilt 3.0‑liter V6 engine producing 286 PS and a newly revised gearbox. The car has been preserved with documentation, race results, and images, having only seen occasional track days since 2003.
